items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: Bass. Charlie Laverton. Madeline. Madeline. Fred Pogginhorn. Madeline. Bud Scott sang. Double Down Madeline. Ed Shaw. Guitar. Mitchell McAllister. Guitar. That was the band consistence.

ctx.x: Bass. Charlie Laverton. Madeline. Madeline. Fred Pogginhorn. Madeline. Bud Scott sang. Double Down Madeline. Ed Shaw. Guitar. Mitchell McAllister. Guitar. That was the band consistence. Six of us. Six of us played at some time. Well, there'd be seven. One of the boys could get away. They had no wind in it. There wasn't much in there at all at that time.
By the way, did you ever know a fellow named Douglas Williams? He played around Mississippi on three, four, clarinet played?
